name: House of Representatives
notes: 360 seats. The last complete party tally found is from 30 October 2025. About 120 members have changed party since July 2024 and at least 60 since that tally, so the blocks are out of date; no newer tally has been published. No member is named here.

name: Senate of Nigeria
notes: 109 seats: three for each of the 36 states and one for the Federal Capital Territory. Who sits and their party are from the Senate's own list of senators (nass.gov.ng), which named 74 on 28 October 2026; the other seats show as 'Not named on the Senate's page', not as vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
